plan.title: Mandatory T&C notice after vendor bid

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Match the initial RFP event type shown when the create screen opens.
Change the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Apply the RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product and quantity; the product's single variant should populate automatically.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields required for publication.
Select the specified delivery location for the line item.

args.goal: open Terms & Conditions on the single-stage RFQ create screen, enable Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory, and stop with that setting visibly enabled

steps.note: Configure the mandatory T&C requirement, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite one available QA test vendor so the event can receive a bid.
Publish the configured RFQ with mandatory T&C enabled.
Confirm the buyer reached the published event page.
Submit a vendor bid so the post-bid event notice can be checked.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Return to the buyer-facing RFQ event page after the bid.

args.text: Vendors who have placed the bid, have accepted the Terms and Conditions.

steps.note: Verify the mandatory T&C notice appears on the event page.
